prompt:
Author a complete interactive program for the user's request. Return source only, no markdown or commentary. It runs until completion, suspending at effects; the host journals results and resumes after human replies. Keep state in program variables/parameters. You may use functions or local macros as useful. No external tools, sampling, imports, or hidden model calls are available.
Capabilities:
ask request: {message:string, suggestions?:string[]} (at most 6 suggestions). Result: {action:"accept",content:{reply:string},exchange:{messages:array,...}} OR {action:"decline"} OR {action:"cancel"}. Read content only on accept. On decline/cancel at any question immediately return {status:action}. Accepted replies are literal user text. Buttons are suggested text, not guaranteed input.
random request: {choices:distinct string[]} OR {min:integer,max:integer}; returns selected string/integer directly. Each executed call records one draw; bind the result if reusing it.
Only the following language features are guaranteed. Source limit 12000 characters. No solution examples are supplied.

LANGUAGE REFERENCE
Tisyn constructor syntax (not JavaScript). One expression with JSON literals.
Let("name",value,body) binds once; Ref("name") reads. LetMany([["name",value],...],body) sequential bindings. If(condition,then,else) evaluates one branch. Seq(a,b) sequences and returns b.
Construct({"key":expression,...}) evaluates object fields. Plain objects are literal data. Arr(expr,...) creates an array. Get(object,"key") reads a field. Concat(string,...) joins strings. Add(a,b), Sub(a,b), Mul(a,b), Eq(a,b), Lt(a,b), Gt(a,b), And(a,b), Or(a,b), Not(a) compute values.
Ask(request) or Eval("ask",request) performs ask; Random(request) performs random. Use Construct for computed request fields. The effect expression returns its result directly.
Fn(["parameter",...],body) defines a function; Call(function,arg,...) calls it. Functions use the caller environment plus parameter bindings. A function bound with Let/LetMany can call itself via Ref. Bindings immutable; carry changing state as recursive parameters. Tail calls supported.
OnAccepted(result,Fn(["content","exchange"],body),Fn(["stop"],body)) runs the matching branch once. stop contains action.
Local syntax macros: WithMacros({"Name":{"params":["x"],"body":expression}},body), Use("Name",argument), Hole("x") in templates. Templates cannot introduce Let/Fn/Ref or nested WithMacros; arguments can contain them. Repeating a Hole repeats evaluation. Prefer functions for state/recursion.

USER REQUEST
Ask me my name, then greet me using exactly what I wrote.

Shared machine-readable completion contract for evaluation:
Return {status:"done",greeting:"Hello, <literal name>!"}. Ask once.
